[[Camp Guard Pongtu]] guards the entrance to a refugee camp.

==Locations==
*[[Kaineng City]]
**{{NPC location|Xaquang Skyway}} (just outside [[Senji's Corner]])

==Quests==
'''Quests involved in:'''
*[[Kaineng City]]
**[[Seeking Shelter]]

==Dialogue==
:''"My captain stationed me here at the camp to help keep order. Ironically, it has become my home. Like most of the refugees here, I lost my family and home to the plague. I know what these people are going through, and it pains me to deny the needy entrance, but I have my orders."''

==Notes==
{{anomaly|In the [[Seeking Shelter]] quest, he is called '''Guardsman Pongtu''' in the objective and dialogues of the quest giver.}}
